Prepare a reference for repeated matching

Source: R/prepared_reference.R
ts_prepare_reference.Rd

Matching names against a reference spends most of its time preparing the reference: finding the genus of every name, parsing the names and building the keys used for comparison. ts_prepare_reference() does the first of these once, and the other two lazily, one genus at a time, the first time a query needs that genus. Pass the result to ts_match_names() or ts_resolve_names() in place of the reference; repeated calls (for example many batches of queries, or an interactive session against a large reference such as WFO or GBIF) then skip work that has already been done.

ts_prepare_reference(reference, strip_qualifiers = FALSE)

Arguments

reference

Character vector of reference names (with authors), or a dataframe of taxonomic data in Darwin Core format (see ts_resolve_names()). A dataframe can be used for both ts_match_names() and ts_resolve_names() (as ref_taxonomy); a character vector only for the former.

strip_qualifiers

Logical; remove standalone open-nomenclature qualifiers (cf., aff., ...) from the reference names before parsing. See ts_parse_names(). Default: FALSE. The setting used here applies to the reference; the strip_qualifiers argument of the matching functions then applies to the query only.

Value

A ts_reference object.

Details

Results are identical to those obtained by passing the reference directly. The object holds the parsed names of every genus used so far, so it grows with use, up to the size of the whole parsed reference.

Examples

data(filmy_taxonomy)
ref <- ts_prepare_reference(filmy_taxonomy)
ref
#> <ts_reference> 2727 names in 67 genera
#>   genera parsed so far: 0 
# Reuse for several calls
ts_match_names("Gonocormus minutum", ref, simple = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   query              reference                      match_type      
#>   <chr>              <chr>                          <chr>           
#> 1 Gonocormus minutum Gonocormus minutus (Bl.) Bosch auto_fuzzy_canon
ts_resolve_names("Gonocormus minutum", ref)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 6
#>   query     resolved_name matched_name resolved_status matched_status match_type
#>   <chr>     <chr>         <chr>        <chr>           <chr>          <chr>     
#> 1 Gonocorm… Crepidomanes… Gonocormus … accepted name   synonym        auto_fuzz…
